label: No actual root could have a determination it lacks
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r of the selected grounding relation at w, every world v accessible from w and every determination d, if r really has d at v then r really has d at w. The root's absences are necessary: it could not have had a determination it actually lacks. It says nothing about why they are necessary. A root whose profile is contingent (as on a Humean recombination account) denies it.
